preconditions.description: The number of photos n must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of albums m must be between 1 and 40.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each album must contain between 1 and 1000 photos.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not solution else len(solution) == n
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output n numbers representing the album indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ti <= m for ti in solution)
postconditions.description: Each output number must be a valid album index between 1 and m.

postconditions.expression: all(solution[i] != solution[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1)) and solution[0] != solution[-1]
postconditions.description: No two consecutive photos in the output can be from the same album, including the first and last photo.
